entries.name: Member Count
entries.description: Show the member and online counts above the member list. Native adaptation of Vencord's MemberCount.

entries.name: Show Me Your Name
entries.description: See account usernames alongside display names in chat and member lists. Native adaptation of Vencord's ShowMeYourName.

entries.name: Account Panel Server Profile
entries.description: Click your account avatar for your main profile. Right-click it for your current server profile. Adapted from the Equicord plugin.

entries.name: Booster Count
entries.description: Show boosts and boost level when hovering a server icon after its metadata has loaded. Native adaptation of Illegalcord's BoosterCount.

entries.name: Quick Mention
entries.description: Insert a message author's mention at the composer cursor from the hover toolbar. Adapted from Vencord's QuickMention.

entries.name: Pin Icon
entries.description: Show a small pin on pinned chat messages. Native adaptation of Equicord's PinIcon.

entries.name: Fast GIF Picker
entries.description: Prefer lighter thumbnails when available and animate only the hovered GIF in the picker. Native adaptation of Illegalcord's FastGifPicker.
